top_concerns: Theory (Props 3.1/3.2) rests on strong assumptions, only bounds the training loss, and does not support the claimed benefits
Baselines are not placement-aware; no control isolating dual reconstruction from simply adding position/node-ID embeddings to MAE; no spatio-temporal/geometry-aware MAE baselines
Gains on Ridgecrest and HAR are within noise; large gains and all ablations only on M3N-VC (authors' own dataset)
Generalization to unseen placements tested on a single held-out scene with randomly reused structural embeddings; learned per-node embeddings conflict with arbitrary-placement claim
Weak baseline tuning and missing non-pretrained/classical localization references limit practical significance
